prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has since sought medical treatment for ongoing injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, email, or in person.

We ask that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, and that you confirm in writing whether coverage has been accepted for this claim. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further request that your insured, and your company, preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, repair and total loss records, and any telematics or dash camera footage. Routine destruction of any such material should be suspended immediately.

We look forward to your prompt response.
